source: swat-model/swatplus @ 62.0.0, pesticide_data_module.f90 (type pesticide_db); cross-checked against pest_parm_read.f90; schema comparison via swatplus-doc-builder schemas/swatplus-62.0.0.json
reason: pesticide.pes was missing the pl_uptake column that SWAT+ 62 reads (the file predates the column; header: SWAT+ Editor 2.2.0, SWAT+ rev.60.5.4). Because SWAT+ reads each record with list-directed I/O over the whole pesticide_db type, the missing column caused the read to consume the next record's tokens -- a real defect, not just a formatting gap. Added pl_uptake to all 233 records as an explicit 0.0 'unknown, assume no uptake' placeholder, deliberately distinct from the SWAT+ Editor's own migration default of 0.01 for this column, so it cannot be mistaken for a real measured value. Manifest status set to needs_review pending SWAT+-team-approved per-pesticide values; tracked in metadata/schema_drift_waivers.json.
notes: Structural schema drift is resolved (columns/types now match SWAT+ 62); the placeholder-value concern remains and is not something automated validation can detect.

source: swat-model/swatplus @ 62.0.0, pathogen_data_module.f90 (type pathogen_db) and path_parm_read.f90; cross-checked against https://tugraskan.github.io/swatplus-enhanced-docs/reference/input-reference/pth/ and swatplus-doc-builder schemas/swatplus-62.0.0.json
reason: pathogens.pth carried an extra column 'SWF' at position 17 (before CONC_MIN) that is not a field of SWAT+ 62's pathogen_db. Because SWAT+ reads each record with list-directed I/O and SWF sat before the end of the 18-field read set, every record's SWF value was silently read into conc_min and the real CONC_MIN value was dropped -- wrong values with no error, not merely a formatting gap. Removed SWF from the header and all 3 records. No value was invented: this is a column removal, not a data addition. The file's remaining values are still the original Little River Experimental Watershed example/seed set and are unaffected by this change; needs_review status is retained for that separate, still-unresolved reason (no real source available).
notes: Structural schema drift is resolved (columns/types now match SWAT+ 62's pathogen_db). Property values remain example/seed data pending a real source.
